title: Named Project Conversion Registry
record_scope: Eight named conversion files that bind existing evidence to one current stage, one downstream artifact, one stop rule, and the reader surfaces that must change when evidence changes.
interpretation_boundary: Registry stages are editorial evidence states, not readiness, performance, risk, probability, or value scores. A record advances only when a source-explicit artifact satisfies the named downstream gate.

records.title: TSMC Arizona campus
records.current_stage: Facility build and bounded production claim
records.established: Phoenix records a Fab 1 volume-production claim, Fab 2 construction completion, a Fab 3 structural milestone, and a project wastewater agreement.
records.unresolved: Named accepted electric capacity, completed wastewater assets, metered service, facility qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat facility-level output remain incomplete.
records.exact_next_artifact: A facility-specific accepted utility, inspection, occupancy, qualification, customer-acceptance, or compatible recurring production record.
records.stop_rule: Do not infer accepted service or campus-wide output from utility territory, an agreement, construction status, or one facility claim.

records.title: Toronto application 24 254930
records.named_entity: Victoria Park Avenue and Thora Avenue application 24 254930
records.current_stage: City Council adoption with amendment bills withheld
records.established: Toronto City Council adopted item 2026.SC33.9 without amendments while retaining wind, land-exchange, and laneway conditions before the amendment bills proceed.
records.unresolved: Enacted instruments, satisfied conditions, servicing, a building permit, financing, start, completion, and occupancy remain open.
records.exact_next_artifact: Introduced or enacted amendment numbers, accepted condition-compliance records, or the first confirmed permit, start, completion, or occupancy record for the application.
records.stop_rule: Do not treat Council adoption as enactment or use aggregate Toronto and CMHC stages as this project's delivery outcome.

records.title: Northern Virginia Golden-Mars and GS-5 large-load trail
records.named_entity: Golden-Mars transmission project and Dominion GS-5 service class
records.current_stage: Conditional transmission authority and approved future rate class
records.established: Virginia has an approved GS-5 large-load rate class and a conditional Golden-Mars transmission decision with a named local route dependency.
records.unresolved: Final route, land rights, construction, inspection, energization, customer agreement, metered service, reliability, and local effects remain open.
records.exact_next_artifact: A final route or land decision followed by construction, inspection, energization, or a named GS-5 customer service record.
records.stop_rule: Do not convert a forecast, rate class, application, or conditional approval into available capacity or accepted customer service.

records.title: Space Coast authorization-to-mission stack
records.named_entity: Shuttle Landing Facility, LC-39A, and SLC-40
records.current_stage: Mixed site and environmental authority with one unresolved licence rail
records.established: LC-39A and SLC-40 have final environmental decisions; the August 15 FAA check leaves the Shuttle Landing Facility public licence disposition unresolved under a bounded No Material Change receipt.
records.unresolved: Formal licence disposition, operator-specific authority, capital acceptance, mission use, utilization, reliability, and local outcomes remain separate gates.
records.exact_next_artifact: The FAA's formal Shuttle Landing Facility licence disposition or a named operator authorization, accepted capital asset, mission, or repeated service record.
records.stop_rule: Do not treat environmental review, a site licence, or an infrastructure milestone as operator approval, mission completion, or corridor reliability.

records.title: Nevada lithium project pair
records.current_stage: Authorized and financed project rails before qualified material
records.established: Thacker Pass has a federal loan close and Rhyolite Ridge has an explicit water-permit pre-operation stack.
records.unresolved: Condition satisfaction, construction, commissioning, compliant operation, product qualification, accepted shipments, and recurring supply remain open.
records.exact_next_artifact: A named inspection, construction completion, commissioning test, compliant operating measurement, qualified lot, customer receipt, or recurring output series.
records.reopening_trigger: An official project, regulator, lender, or customer record reaches construction acceptance, commissioning, compliance, qualification, shipment, or recurring output.
records.stop_rule: Do not convert authorization, a permit, financial close, projected capacity, or reserve context into qualified domestic supply.

records.title: GSA post-quantum acquisition path
records.current_stage: Named federal procurement mechanism before an agency migration
records.established: GSA maps inventory, planning, implementation, maintenance, training, and use cases to acquisition support and contract vehicles.
records.unresolved: A named agency order, validated implementation, tested cutover, operational acceptance, and vulnerable-system retirement remain open.
records.exact_next_artifact: A named agency inventory, solicitation, award, interoperability test, cutover, acceptance, or legacy-retirement record.
records.reopening_trigger: An official agency or GSA record identifies a named PQC procurement or system migration milestone.
records.stop_rule: Do not treat a buyer's guide, standard, draft credential specification, or deadline as an order or completed migration.

records.title: NIST ARIA assurance path
records.current_stage: Multi-level evaluation pilot before continuous system assurance
records.established: NIST evaluated seven AI applications from five organizations through model testing, red teaming, and field testing.
records.unresolved: Named operating authorization, continuous monitoring, incidents, corrective action, independent review, and comparable mission outcomes remain open.
records.exact_next_artifact: A named system evaluation and authorization record linked to deployment monitoring, incident handling, corrective action, or a stable mission-outcome measure.
records.reopening_trigger: NIST or a participating institution publishes a named system-level assurance, deployment, or outcome artifact.
records.stop_rule: Do not treat an evaluation pilot, framework, inventory, or purchasing channel as assured operation or measured benefit.

records.title: Waymo California fared driverless service
records.named_entity: Waymo fared driverless passenger service in California
records.current_stage: Expanded service authority before a comparable persistent-outcome series
records.established: CPUC authorized fared driverless service in specified Los Angeles and San Francisco Peninsula areas and requires detailed operator reporting.
records.unresolved: A current public rollup of service miles, rides, availability, interventions, safety, accessibility, cost, complaints, and coverage remains incomplete.
records.exact_next_artifact: A stable Waymo operating series with geography, period, service exposure, rides, interventions, safety events, accessibility, complaints, and comparable definitions.
records.reopening_trigger: CPUC or another official California authority publishes a current operator-level passenger-service and outcome rollup.
records.stop_rule: Do not convert legal authority, testing miles, or a reporting requirement into persistent service quality, safety, accessibility, or adoption.
